remaining_cautions.evidence_context: DRAMP rows list antimicrobial/anticancer activity for 21 Xentry variants, but XML/PDF/supplement material supports cell penetration, MMP-9 activatable uptake, and non-toxicity/viability rather than antimicrobial MIC/MBC or anticancer killing endpoints.
Table 1 uses visual uptake scores (-,+,++,+++) and NT cells; these are preserved as qualitative uptake rows and not normalized to concentration-response potency.
Figures 4/5/8 are local images, but exact bar heights are not tabulated; source text and Table 1 provide gate-relevant qualitative/approximate values.
